blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Purpose: Most Greek papyri are unpublished and undigitised; a handwritten text recognition (HTR) pipeline that transcribes them automatically would allow scholars to find new ancient documents and literary works which remained unread and unknown before. Recognition systems for Ancient Greek papyri are in statu nascendi , and how accurate such a system must be for a certain papyrological task has so far been unexamined. To answer this question and set a benchmark for HTR systems of Greek papyri, we test various character error rates of HTR against four papyrological tasks, using published editions of papyri as ground truth. Methods: From 63,846 current editions of Greek texts in papyri.info, we imitate a letters-only “perfect HTR” output text by removing the editorial layer, then degrade it with a seeded algorithm to exact CERs of 1–50%, with lost lines and four error-shape variants. Using these data, we train several small models (TF-IDF, fastText, a character CNN, ByT5-small) for establishing the type of the document, dating, documentary-versus-literary classification, and apply eight search methods for keyword search. We measure the difference between these models being clean-trained and retrained on a specific CER level, and the evaluation is further differentiated across various CERs. Results: Tolerance differs between tasks. On average, when using clean-trained models, documentary-versus-literary classification keeps 90% of its metric up to 20% CER. For establishing the type of document, the same 90% of metric is achieved with CER up to 7.5%; for subtypes and search – up to 5%; and for dating – only up to 3%. When the model is retrained using text that contains character errors, the severe performance degradation that normally occurs when the error rate exceeds 15% is largely eliminated. Models are usually more tolerant of concentrated damage in a long document than of small errors spread throughout a short piece of text. Conclusion: The study gives a CER target for each of the four papyrological tasks and shows that models trained on noisy text make text recognition in its current imperfect state useful for these tasks.
blocks.zh: 目的:大多数希腊语papyri是未出版和未数字化的;手写文字识别(HTR)管道自动将其转录,可以让学者找到新的古代文献和文学作品,这些文献和文献至今仍未被读取,而且以前也未知. Ancient Greek papyri的识别系统处于statu nascendi 中,迄今为止尚未对此种系统对于某种帕皮病学任务的准确性进行审查。 为了回答这个问题并为希腊papyri的HTR系统设定基准,我们对照四个papyrylogy任务测试HTR的各种字符错误率,使用已出版的papyri版本作为地面真理. 方法: 从63 846 现版的 papyri.info 中,我们通过删除编辑层来模仿只写字母的“完美 HTR ” 输出文本,然后用种子算法将其降解,精确到 1-50% 的 CER, 丢失的行和四个错误形状的变体。 利用这些数据,我们培养了几个小模型(TF-IDF, fastText,一个人物CNN,ByT5-small),用于确定文件的类型,约会,文献与文学分类,并应用八种搜索方法进行关键词搜索. 我们衡量这些模型在具体CER水平上经过清洁培训和再培训之间的差别,评估在各种CER之间有进一步的区别。 结果: 任务之间的容忍程度不同。 平均而言,在使用经过清洁训练的模型时,文献分类与文学分类将90%的衡量标准维持在20%的CER。 在确定文件类型时,同样的90%的公制是用CER达到7.5%;亚型和搜索达到5%;约会达到3%。 当使用包含字符错误的文本重新训练模型时,通常在错误率超过15%时发生的严重性能退化被基本消除. 模型通常对长文件中的集中损害比在短文本中散布的小错误更为宽容. 结论: 研究为四个papyrological任务中的每一个都给出了CER目标,并显示经过吵闹文本培训的模型使得文本识别在目前不完善状态下对这些任务有用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Papyri are the largest body of first-hand written evidence for the ancient Mediterranean, and most of them have never been read. Large collections worldwide hold in total between 1,000,000 and 1,500,000 excavated fragments, of which less than 10% has been edited and published despite more than a century of papyrological work Van Minnen (2009) . Each edition requires days and sometimes weeks of expert labour: the papyrologist reads a damaged, often cursive text written without word division, restores lost passages, expands abbreviations and normalises spellings, and only after the text is established in this way can it be analysed historically, compared with other documents and added to databases. The unedited majority of papyri remain invisible to digital tools, and a scholar who wants to know whether a formula, a name or a certain document type occurs among the unpublished papyri has no way to ask.
blocks.zh: 帕皮里是古地中海地区第一手第一手书面证据中最大的一个体,大多数从未被读过. 全球大型藏品共计有1 000 000至1 500 000块挖掘出来的碎片,其中不到10%已编辑出版,尽管范明宁做了一个多世纪的乳房学工作(2009年)。 每版需要数日,有时需要数周的专家劳动: 帕皮尔学家读到一个损坏的,常常是无文字划分的拼写文字,恢复丢失的段落,扩展缩写和普通拼写,只有在文本以这种方式建立之后,才能在历史上进行分析,与其他文档相比,并添加到数据库中. 未经编辑的大多数papyri仍然对数字工具看不见,一位学者想知道在未出版的papyri中是否发生一个公式,一个名称或某个文件类型.

blocks.en: Automatic transcription would change this. If handwritten text recognition (HTR) could turn images of unedited papyri into text, even though imperfect, this text layer could be searched for parallels, sorted by type and date, before each single fragment receives a proper papyrological edition, and the scarce expert attention could go where the automatic pass says it matters. In the last few years, the ICDAR 2023 competition on detecting and recognising Greek letters on papyri Seuret et al (2023) and its follow-ups Turnbull and Mannix (2024) , citizen-science character datasets Swindall et al (2021) , end-to-end systems such as Anagnostes Chepel and Repushko (2026) , and, for the printed side, OCR of Greek critical editions Robertson and Boschetti (2017) ; Angleraud et al (2026) ; Karamolegkou et al (2026) have all shown some progress in this direction.
blocks.zh: 自动转录会改变这一点。 如果手写文字识别(HTR)可以将未经编辑的papyri的图像转换成文字,即使不完美,这个文字层也可以被搜索到平行,按类型和日期排序,然后每个片段才能收到适当的papyrological版,而很少的专家注意力可以去自动通行证所说的重要之处. 在过去几年中,ICDAR 2023关于检测和识别希腊字母papyri Seuret等人(2023年)及其后续作品Turnbull和Mannix(2024年),公民-科学字符数据集的比赛. Swindall等人(2021年),端对端系统,如Anagnostes Chepel和Repushko(2026年),以及希腊批判版Robertson和Boschetti的OCR(2017年); Angleraud等人(2026年);Karamolegkou等人(2026年)都表明在这方面取得了一些进展。

blocks.en: In these previous studies, character error rates have been reported as performance metrics. However, the authors have not answered the question which would be relevant for a papyrologist or a collection curator: which of these error rates are good enough for which tasks? Studies on modern and early-modern print have shown that the impact of OCR noise is strongly task dependent Traub et al (2015) ; Chiron et al (2017) ; Hill and Hengchen (2019) ; van Strien et al (2020) ; Hamdi et al (2023) ; Todorov and Colavizza (2022) , but none of them covers the special characteristics of papyri: scriptio continua without word division, lacunae inside the text, fragments of a few letters, a highly formulaic documentary language, and other features that are specific to the discipline.
blocks.zh: 在这些之前的研究中,人物错误率被报告为性能度量. 然而,提交人没有回答一个与帕皮医生或收藏管理员相关的问题:这些错误率中哪一个足以胜任哪些任务? 关于现代和早期印刷的研究表明,OCR噪声的影响很大程度上依赖于Traub等人(2015年);Chiron等人(2017年);Hill和Hengchen(2019年);van Strien等人(2020年);Hamdi等人(2023年);Todorov和Colavizza(2022年),但都没有涉及papyri的特殊性:没有字词划分的脚本continua,文字中的空白,几个字母的片段,一种高度公式化的文献语言,以及该学科特有的其他特征.

blocks.en: In this paper, we directly measure tolerance. We start with the text of current editions in papyri.info and work backwards: stripping each edition of everything an HTR system cannot see; imitating what a perfect HTR would return; then degrading that transcription to various CERs and observing their effect on each of the four papyrological tasks.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们直接衡量容忍。 我们从目前版本的papyri文本开始。 信息和工作向后:剥离每个版本的HTR系统无法看到的一切;模仿一个完美的HTR会返回什么;然后降低对各种CER的复制,并观察其对四个帕皮学任务中每个任务的影响。

blocks.en: The contributions include: 1. A documented imitation of “perfect HTR” text produced from the EpiDoc XML encoded text of editions: a set of rules that keep only the ink on the papyrus and reduce it to letters, with gap tokens and line breaks as unscored structure (Sect. 5 ). 2. A degradation algorithm that hits an exact CER per corpus under a verified Levenshtein invariant, with lost lines and four error-shape variants, so that “10% CER” means the same thing in every cell (Sect. 5.3 ). 3. Four tasks with real labels on 63,846 Greek documents: document type from the Grammateus typology, dating from HGV metadata, documentary versus literary from DDbDP versus DCLP, and search with dictionary stems, names, formulae and random substrings (Sect. 4 ). The main finding is that tolerance differs between tasks, and that for the tasks which collapse, retraining on noisy text recovers most of the loss. A perfect HTR is not necessary; the CER required for each task lies within reach of current systems.
blocks.zh: 捐款包括: 1. 由EpiDoc XML编码版本文本制成的 " 完美HTR " 文本的有记录的仿制:一套规则,只保留papyrus上的墨水,将其缩小为字母,空白符号和换行符作为无记分结构(第5节)。 2. 一种降解算法,在经过核实的Levenshtein invariant下击中准确的CER peruc,其线条和四个误差变体,因此, " 10%的CER " 在每个单元格中都具有同样的含义(第5.3节)。 3. 在63 846份希腊文件中,有四个具有真实标签的任务:来自Grammateus类型的文件类型,可追溯到HGV元数据,DDbDP对DCLP的文献对文学,以及用词典词根、名称、公式和随机子字符串进行搜索(第4节)。 主要的发现是,任务之间的容忍度不同,对于崩溃的任务,对吵闹的文字进行再培训可以挽回大部分损失. 完全的HTR是不必要的;每项任务所需的核证排减量是现有系统所能达到的。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Character-level detection and recognition on papyrus images was the objective of the ICDAR 2023 competition Seuret et al (2023) , whose winning recognition entry combined YOLOv8 detection with DeiT and SimCLR classifiers Turnbull and Mannix (2024) . Earlier work used crowdsourced character annotations from the Ancient Lives project to train and evaluate classifiers Swindall et al (2021) . Line- and page-level transcription systems are more recent; Anagnostes Chepel and Repushko (2026) reports an average letters-only CER of about ten to eighteen percent over literary and documentary hands, with the best categories below ten percent. For printed polytonic Greek, large-scale OCR of critical editions reaches low CERs on clean nineteenth-century typography Robertson and Boschetti (2017) , and recent transformer systems handle the structure of critical editions Angleraud et al (2026) ; vision-language models, by contrast, have been shown to guess rather than read Greek Karamolegkou et al (2026) . None of these works measures what their output is useful for.
blocks.zh: 在papyrus图像上的字符级检测和识别是ICDAR 2023比赛 Seuret et al (2023)的目标,其获奖识别条目将YOLOv8检测与DeiT和SimCLR分类器Turnbul和Mannix(2024)合并. 早期的作品使用来自Ancient Lives项目的众源人物说明来训练和评价分类员Swindall等人(2021年). 排行和页级的抄写系统比较新; Anagnostes Chepel and Repushko (2026年) 报告说,文学和文献手平均只有10%至18%的只写CER,最佳类别低于10%。 对于印刷的多音节希腊语,大型临界版的OCR通过清洁的十九世纪排版Robertson和Boschetti(2017年)达到低CER,最近的变压器系统处理临界版的结构. Angleraud等人(2026年);相形之下,视觉语言模型已被显示为猜测而不是读希腊语Karamolegkou等人(2026年). 所有这些工作都没有衡量其产出对什么有用。

blocks.en: Most machine-learning work on ancient Greek text takes edited text as input. Ithaca restores lacunae and attributes inscriptions to a place and a date Assael et al (2022) ; the survey by Sommerschield et al. Sommerschield et al (2023) covers other methods in this field. Several approaches have been applied to dating papyri. Text regression estimates a document’s date from its transcription Pavlopoulos et al (2023) , while instruction-tuned language models restore, date and localise both papyri and inscriptions Cullhed (2024) . The Hell-Date benchmark, in turn, compares image-based dating methods with the judgements of palaeographers De Gregorio et al (2024) . The Grammateus project provides a typology of documentary papyri that we use as document-type labels Ferretti et al (2023) . All of the text-based systems assume clean edited input; our question is what happens to such tasks when the input comes from HTR instead.
blocks.zh: 大多数古老的机器学习工作 希腊文本将编辑过的文本作为输入。 伊萨卡将空白和属性铭文恢复到一个地方和一个日期Assael等人(2022年);由Sommerschield等人进行的调查. Sommerschield等人(2023年)涵盖了这一领域的其他方法。 在约会Papyri方面采用了几种方法。 文本回归估计,文件的转录日期是Pavlopoulos et al(2023年),而经指导调整的语言模型则恢复、日期和本地化的papyri和铭文Cullhed(2024年)。 Hell-Date基准反过来比较了基于图像的约会方法与古生物学家De Gregorio et al(2024)的判断. Grammateus项目提供了我们用作文档类型标签的纪录片papyri的类型Ferretti等人(2023年). 所有基于文本的系统都假定有经过编辑的干净输入;我们的问题是,当输入来自HTR时,这些任务会发生什么。

blocks.en: For printed historical documents the effect of OCR noise on research tasks has been studied repeatedly. Traub et al. Traub et al (2015) and Chiron et al. Chiron et al (2017) looked at retrieval and use in digital libraries, Hill and Hengchen Hill and Hengchen (2019) at text analysis on eighteenth-century print, van Strien et al. van Strien et al (2020) across a range of NLP tasks, Hamdi et al. Hamdi et al (2023) at named-entity recognition and linking, and Todorov and Colavizza Todorov and Colavizza (2022) at language models; post-OCR correction is surveyed in Nguyen et al (2021) . These studies share our conclusion that impact is task dependent, but they work on running text of substantial length with word divisions and mostly with real OCR output whose error rate cannot be varied at will. We instead control the error rate exactly, vary its shape, and evaluate tasks and text that are specific to papyrology.
blocks.zh: 对于印刷的历史文件,已反复研究OCR噪声对研究任务的影响。 特劳布等人. Traub等人(2015年)和Chiron等人著. Chiron等人(2017年)研究了数字图书馆,Hill和Hengchen Hill和Hengchen(2019年)在18世纪印刷品上的文本分析,van Strien等人(2020年)在一系列NLP任务的检索和使用,Hamdi等人. Hamdi等人(2023年)在命名实体的识别和连接上,Todorov和Colavizza Todorov和Colavizza(2022年)在语言模型上;OCR后修正在Nguyen等人(2021年)中调查. 这些研究分享了我们的结论,即影响取决于任务,但它们致力于用字段来运行大量长度的文本,而且大多是实际OCR输出,其错误率不能随意变化. 相反,我们准确地控制了错误率, 改变了它的形状, 并评价了与papyrology有关的任务和文字。

blocks.en: 3.2 Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.2 企业

blocks.en: Every edition is rendered to its HTR view (Sect. 5 ). DDbDP records whose text is reprinted in another record (8,777 reprint-in stubs) are dropped, leaving 63,846 documents with 18.6 million letters: 57,814 documentary (DDbDP) and 6,032 literary or subliterary (DCLP). Letters per document are heavily skewed: 10th percentile 9, median 106, 90th percentile 632, maximum 161,212. 4,547 documents have no letters at all in the HTR view, 3,860 of them DCLP catalogue records without a transcription; they cannot be predicted from text and are excluded from the model metrics.
blocks.zh: 每个版本都提供给其HTR视图(第5节)。 DDbDP记录,其文本在另一唱片中再版(8,777份重印在分页)被删除,留下63,846份文件,有1,860万个字母:57,814个记录(DDbDP)和6,032个文学或子文学(DCLP). 每份文件的字母严重扭曲:第10百分位数9,中位数106,第90百分位数632,最高161,212。 4,547份文件在HTR观点中根本没有字母,其中3,860份是DCLP目录记录,没有抄录;无法从文本中预测这些文件,被排除在模型衡量标准之外。

blocks.en: 3.3 Splits
blocks.zh: 3.3 分块

blocks.en: Documents are grouped so that no papyrus and no near-duplicate text can appear on both sides of a split: two texts land in one group if they belong to the same document (established by a shared TM number) and if their letters-only 5-gram sets have an estimated Jaccard similarity of at least 0.8 (MinHash with 128 permutations Broder (1997) ). Groups are assigned to train, validation and test (80/10/10) by a seeded hash of the group’s smallest identifier, giving 51,042, 6,370 and 6,434 documents. The document-type task has too few labelled papyri for a fixed split and uses five-fold grouped cross-validation stratified by type (folds of 355–356 papyri). Hyperparameters of every model are tuned once on the clean validation split and frozen for every noise level.
blocks.zh: 文件被归为一组,这样一来,一个拆分的两边就不会出现papyrus和任何近似复制的文本:如果两个文本属于同一个文件(由共享的TM号码建立),并且如果它们仅有字母的5克的套件的Jacard相似性估计至少为0.8(MinHash有128 permutions Broder(1997年))。 团体被指派进行训练、验证和测试(80/10/10),由团体最小标识的种子散列进行,提供51 042、6 370和6 434份文件。 文档类型的任务对于固定的拆分来说,标签的papyri太少了,并且使用五倍的分组式交叉验证分层按类型排列(重复355–356 papyri). 每一个模型的超参数 都会被调用一次 在干净的验证分解 和冻结每个噪音水平。

blocks.en: 4 Tasks and the data behind each of them
blocks.zh: 页:1 任务及其背后的数据

blocks.en: Table 1 lists the four tasks. Each has a headline metric and a trivial baseline (the majority class or the median training date). Tasks were chosen to cover what a papyrologist would want to do with an unedited text: tell a document from a literary fragment, identify what type of document it is, date it, and establish its thematic content with keywords present in the text. Literary attribution and editorial text reconstruction are left for later work.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了四项任务。 每个都有一个标题衡量尺度和一个微不足道的基线(多数班级或中位培训日期)。 选择的任务包括一个papyrlogist想要与未经编辑的文本有关的内容:从文学片段告诉文件,确定文件的种类,日期,并用文本中的关键词确定其主题内容。 文学属性和编辑文本的重建留待以后进行.

blocks.en: Table 1: The four tasks, the data behind each and how they are scored. Counts are documents with at least one letter; validation and test are the evaluated subsets. T1 uses five-fold grouped cross-validation over all its papyri
blocks.zh: 表1:四项任务,每项任务背后的数据和如何得分. 计数是至少有一个字母的文档;验证和测试是评价的子集. T1在其所有papyri上使用五倍分组交叉验证

blocks.en: 4.1 T1: document type
blocks.zh: 4.1 T1: 文档类型

blocks.en: Papyrologists identify the genre of the document by formulas, as well as by the structure and layout of the text. For this task, both for humans and machines, the size of the fragment and the amount of preserved words are crucial. In the Grammateus dataset that we used, the majority of papyri are complete or near-complete.
blocks.zh: 帕皮尔学家通过公式以及文本的结构和布局来识别文档的流派. 对于这项任务,无论是对人类还是机器来说,碎片的大小和保存下来的字数都是至关重要的. 在我们使用的Grammateus数据集中,大多数papyri是完整或接近完成的.

blocks.en: The Grammateus typology groups documentary papyri by the formal relation they establish between the parties: Epistolary Exchange (569 papyri in our set), Objective Statement (483), Transmission of Information (437) and Recording of Information (287). Below the types are subtypes such as receipt, list, business letter, syngraphe, private letter, cheirographon or petition; we keep the 16 subtypes with at least 30 papyri (1,665 documents) as a harder 16-class variant. The metric is macro-F1 over the pooled folds. The labelled papyri are long (median 410 letters), so this task sees more text per document than the others.
blocks.zh: 格鲁玛底斯类型学小组通过双方建立的正式关系建立纪录片papyri:Esistory Exchange (569 papyri in our set),目标声明(483),传送信息(437)和记录信息(287)。 以下类型是子类型,如收据,列表,商务信,语录,私信,芝麻或请愿;我们保留了至少30 papyri(1,665文件)的16个子类型,作为更难的16级变体. 衡量标准是宏-F1,高于集合折叠。 标注的 papyri 长(中间410个字母),因此这个任务看到每个文档的文本比其他的要多.

blocks.en: 4.2 T2: dating

Papyrologists usually establish the date of a document by looking at the handwriting and searching the text for historical indications, such as the name of a known person, economic or social institutions, and others. If the text of the fragment contains no dating formula or other restrictive indications, this dating remains subjective. By convention, such rough dating is placed within the boundaries of a century, as reflected in the HGV metadata. The dating done by a model uses only text analysis and is free of this conventional bias.
blocks.zh: 帕皮尔学家通常通过查看笔迹和搜索文字以寻找历史标志来确定文件的日期,例如已知的人的名字,经济或社会机构等. 如果片段的文字中没有约会公式或其他限制性标志,这种约会仍然是主观的. 根据惯例,这种粗略的约会被置于一个世纪的界限之内,这反映在HGV元数据中。 一个模型完成的约会只使用文本分析,没有这种传统的偏差.

blocks.en: HGV gives a date interval for 55,410 of our documents. Training uses every dated document (43,803) with the interval midpoint as target; evaluation is restricted to documents whose interval is at most 100 years wide (4,681 evaluated test documents), so that the reference date is meaningful. The headline metric is the mean absolute error (MAE) in years; we also record the share of predictions inside the editor’s interval and the century accuracy. The always-median baseline errs by 184 years. Dates range from the fourth century BCE to the eighth century CE with a peak in the second century CE.
blocks.zh: HGV给出了55,410个文件的日期间隔. 培训使用每份日期文件(43 803份),以间隔中点为目标;评价仅限于间隔最长100年的文件(4 681份经过评估的测试文件),因此参考日期有意义。 标题度量是年中平均绝对误差(MAE);我们也记录编辑器间隔和世纪准确度内预测的比例. 总是中间基线误差184年。 日期范围从4世纪的BCE到8世纪的CE,在2世纪的CE有一个高峰.

blocks.en: 4.3 T3: documentary versus literary
blocks.zh: 4.3 T3: 纪录片与文学

blocks.en: Documentary and literary papyri constitute two very different groups of texts that are studied by historians and philologists using different approaches. The two groups already differed greatly in quantity in antiquity: the vast number of everyday documents far exceeded the number of literary works copied on papyrus. Text loss is also distributed unevenly between documentary and literary fragments. Literary fragments usually represent only tiny portions of a long poem or book, whereas documentary papyri often preserve complete or nearly complete documents. From the lexical point of view, literary and documentary papyri often have very little in common, since documents reflect bureaucratic, legal, and mundane language, while literature tends to use sublime, elevated, and archaic style.
blocks.zh: 文献学和文学派皮里是历史学家和哲学家采用不同方法研究的两种截然不同的文本组. 这两个团体在数量上在古代已经大不相同:每天的大量文件远远超过了复制在papyrus上的文学作品的数量. 文字损失在纪录片和文学片段之间也分布不均. 文学片段通常只代表长诗或书籍的极小部分,而纪录片papyri往往保存完整或接近完整的文件. 从词汇学的观点来看,文学和文献papyri的共同点往往很少,因为文献反映了官僚主义,法律主义和庸俗主义的语言,而文学则倾向于使用次高,高,古的风格.

blocks.en: A text from DDbDP counts as documentary and a text from DCLP as literary or subliterary. Papyri present in both databases (by TM) are removed. Only 3.4% of evaluated test documents are literary, because most DCLP records carry no transcription, so macro-F1 carries the headline. To check that the task is not solved by the number of lines and the number of letters alone, a model that sees only line-length statistics is reported alongside the text models.
blocks.zh: DDbDP的文本算作文件,DCLP的文本算作文学或子文学。 两个数据库(TM)中的Papyri被移除。 只有3.4%的评价测试文件是文学的,因为大多数DCLP记录没有带抄本,因此宏F1带有标题. 要检查任务不是单靠行数和字母数解决,只看到行长统计的模型与文本模型一起报告.

blocks.en: 4.4 T4: search

The first examination of an unedited papyrus by a papyrologist, whether for catalogue description or the preparation of the first transcription, involves identifying words and phrases that are relevant to the document’s content and may point to parallels in other papyri. The difference between the papyrologist and the machine in this context is that the human researcher recognises what is present in the text and what is relevant, whereas the machine searches for predefined words and strings of text.
blocks.zh: 一名papyrlogist对未经编辑的papyrus的首次检查,无论是为目录说明还是为编写第一份转录,都涉及识别与文件内容有关的词语和短语,并可能指向其他papyri中的类似内容。 乳腺学家和机器在这方面的区别在于,人类研究者承认文本中的内容和相关的内容,而机器则搜索预定义的文字和文字的串.

blocks.en: Search is the task most directly tied to unedited material: a papyrologist would want to look for a word, a name or a formula among unpublished papyri in a collection. Queries are letters-only strings of four kinds: 1,000 stems of Preisigke headwords (the headword with its longest inflectional ending removed, kept if the stem occurs in clean training text and in at least one test document), 500 capitalised word forms from the editions (proper nouns: people, places, gods, months), 34 documentary formulae such as χαιρειν, ετους or ερρωςϑαι ςε ευχομαι, and 1,000 random substrings of 3–12 letters of clean test lines. A unit (a document or a line) is relevant to a query when the query occurs in its clean text as an exact substring; relevance never changes with noise. There are 5,961 test documents and 96,410 test lines with letters. Ranking methods are scored by recall@20 (relevant units in the top 20 divided by min ⁡ ( relevant , 20 ) \min(\text{relevant},20) ), MRR and nDCG@10; filtering methods by micro precision, recall and F1 over all hits.
blocks.zh: 搜索是最直接与未经编辑的材料联系在一起的任务:在收集的未出版的papyri中,一个papyrylogist想要寻找一个词,一个名字或一个公式. 查询是四种唯字母的字符串:1000根Preisigke头词(其最长的词尾被移除,如果该词尾出现在干净的训练文本和至少一个测试文件中,则保留),500个来自版本的大写字表(适当的名词:人,地点,神,月),34个文件公式,如QQ,QQQ或QQQ,1000个随机子字符串3–12个干净测试行. 一个单元(一个文档或一行)与查询相关,当查询在其干净的文本中作为精确的子字符串发生时;相关性从不随噪音而变化. 有5,961份测试文件,96,410条带字母的测试线. 排名方法通过回击@20(前20名的相关单位除以分钟______(相关,20)\min(\text{相关},20)),MRR和nDCG@10来评分;通过微精度,回击和F1在所有点击中过滤方法.

blocks.en: 5 From the edited text to HTR output at an exact CER
blocks.zh: 页:1 从编辑文本到精确CER的 HTR 输出

Apion给父亲的信(BGU II 423 = Chrest.Wilck. 480)中的第1至第2行和第19至第20行编码为DDbDP版(L0;方括号内附有恢复的字母,点标记不确定的字母),编辑层(仅链接;□\平方标记丢失文本)被删除,文本将简化为字母(L3),一个完美的HTR系统将会返回. 最后三行是被研究的算法退化到准确的5,15和30%CER的相同线条,默认为 3:1:1 混合:一个替换字母为粗体,一个插入字母为粗体和下划线,一个删除的字母为粗体标记. 每个编辑都花费一个Levensshtein步骤,漏洞符号从不触碰

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows the three levels and their degradation on a real papyrus. The first half of the pipeline answers a question that has no obvious answer: what is the perfect HTR of a papyrus? An edition is not it. Editors restore lost letters in brackets, resolve abbreviations, normalise errors and omissions, add accents, breathings and word spaces, and mark uncertain readings; none of this is on the papyrus, and an HTR system that returned it would be doing philology, not recognition. We therefore define three levels and measure only the last.
blocks.zh: 图1显示三种水平及其在真papyrus上的降解。 管道的上半部分回答了一个没有明显答案的问题:一个papyrus的完美HTR是什么? 一个版本不是它。 编辑器在括号中恢复丢失的字母,解析缩略语,使错误和遗漏正常化,添加重音,呼吸和文字空间,并标记不确定的读数;这些都没有在papyrus上,返回它的HTR系统会做哲学,而不是识别. 因此,我们确定了三个层次,只衡量最后一个层次。

blocks.en: 5.1 Levels
blocks.zh: 5.1 职等

blocks.en: L0, the edition , is the EpiDoc XML encoded text. Ink only removes the editorial layer by the rules listed in Appendix 12 : whatever the scribe wrote stays, whatever the editor added goes, and lost text becomes one gap token □ \square per contiguous loss. L3, letters only , normalises what remains: Unicode NFD, combining marks dropped, lowercase, the two sigma forms folded to one, and only the 24 letters α \alpha – ω \omega plus the three archaic numeral letters stigma, koppa and sampi kept; accents, breathings, punctuation, brackets, digits and other scripts are removed. Line breaks are kept, because lines are visible on the papyrus and HTR systems work line by line; word spaces are dropped, because the papyrus has none.
blocks.zh: L0,该版是EpiDoc XML编码文本. 墨水只通过附录12所列规则去除编辑层 : 无论文士写作留下的, 编辑添加的, 丢失的文本变成一个空隙符号 ^\ 平方每连带损失. L3,只有字母,使剩下的东西正常化: Unicode NFD,结合标记抛出,小写,两个sigma形式折叠成一个,只有24个字母α\alpha – \\ omega + 三个古代数字字母的污名, koppa 和 sampi 保存; 重音, 呼吸, 标点, 括号, 数字和其他脚本被删除. 换行符被保留,因为线条在papyrus和HTR系统工作线上逐行可见;字位被丢掉,因为papyrus没有.

blocks.en: The rules were fixed against editions before any experiment and are documented in the released code; the element inventory that motivated them (Table 1 in Appendix 12 ) was measured over the whole corpus. Two decisions deserve comment. Restorations are removed even though a strong language model could guess many of them, because an HTR system sees no ink there; lacuna restoration is a separate task. Uncertain letters ( unclear , the dotted letters of an edition) are kept, because the ink is there and a recognition system would produce something ; whether it produces the right letter is exactly what the degradation models.
blocks.zh: 这些规则在任何试验之前是按版本确定的,并在公布的代码中加以记录;刺激这些规则的要素清单(附录12表1)是对整个要素的衡量。 两项决定值得评论。 修复被移除,即使一个强大的语言模型可以猜测其中的许多,因为一个HTR系统看到那里没有墨水;空白修复是一个单独的任务. 不确定的字母(不明确,一个版本的点字母)被保留,因为墨水存在,一个识别系统会产生一些东西;它是否产生正确的字母正是降解模型的所在.

blocks.zh: 5.2 结构符号和核证的排减量

CER is the letters-only Levenshtein distance Levenshtein (1966) between reference and hypothesis divided by the number of reference letters, micro-averaged over the evaluated text: CER = ∑ d Lev ⁡ ( ref d , hyp d ) ∑ d | ref d | , \mathrm{CER}=\frac{\sum_{d}\mathrm{Lev}(\mathrm{ref}_{d},\mathrm{hyp}_{d})}{\sum_{d}|\mathrm{ref}_{d}|}, (1) where the sums run over documents d d and the strings contain letters only. blocks.en: 5.3 Degradation at an exact CER
blocks.zh: 5.3 准确CER的降解

blocks.en: Real HTR output on unedited papyri does not exist at the scale and with the aligned ground truth this study needs, and its error rate cannot be set. We therefore degrade the L3 text synthetically, under four constraints that make the CER exact and the errors well defined:
blocks.zh: 在未经编辑的papyri上真实的HTR输出在尺度上并不存在,并且与本研究需要的对齐的地面真实性一致,其错误率无法设定. 因此,我们将L3文本合成地降解,在使CER准确性和错误得到明确界定的四个限制之下:

blocks.en: 1. Edit budget. For a split (train, validation or test) and a target CER c c , the budget is K = round ⁡ ( c ⋅ N ) K=\mathrm{round}(c\cdot N) edits, N N being the letters on the kept lines of the split, apportioned to documents in proportion to their letters, so the split CER equals c c exactly and each document is within one edit of it. 2. Positions. A document’s edits land on a uniformly random, pairwise non-adjacent subset of its letters. Gap tokens are never edited, and letters on the two sides of a gap do not count as adjacent. 3. Edit types. Each edit is a substitution, an insertion or a deletion with probabilities 3:1:1. A substitution writes a uniformly random letter other than the original; an insertion (before the edited letter) a letter different from both neighbours; a deletion never removes a letter equal to a neighbour. 4. Invariant. By construction every edit costs exactly one Levenshtein step, so the distance between the clean and the degraded letters of a document equals its edit count. This is verified on every document of every corpus. Every edit is logged with its line, offset and type, so any truth defined on the clean text can be projected onto the degraded text, and every random draw is seeded from the cell’s parameters and the document identifier, so each document is reproducible independently of processing order. Four further variants spend the same budget in a different pattern — substitutions only, a uniform mix, bursts of 2–4 consecutive letters, and an uneven per-line rate — and are defined and analysed in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 编辑预算。 对于拆分(火车,验证或测试)和目标CER c c ,预算为K = round ⁡ (c ⋅ N) K =\ mathrm{round}(c\cdot N) 编辑,N为拆分时保留行上的字母,按其字母的比例分配到文档,因此拆分CER 准确为 c ,每个文档都在其中一个编辑范围内. 2. 职位。 文档的编辑以一个一致的随机、对偶、非相邻的字母子集进行。 空白符号从未编辑过,空白两侧的字母不算作邻. 3. 编辑类型。 每次编辑都是替换、插入或删除,概率为3:1:1。 替换者会写一个除原字母以外的统一随机字母;插入(在编辑后字母之前)一个与两个邻居不同的字母;删除后不会删除一个与邻居相等的字母. 4. 不稳定。 通过构建每个编辑都花费了一个莱文施泰因步骤,所以一个文档的干净字母和退化字母之间的距离等于其编辑数. 这在每份文书上都有证实 每个编辑都用其行,偏移和类型进行记录,因此在干净文本上定义的任何真理都可以投射到退化文本上,并且每个随机绘图都从单元格的参数和文档标识符中引出,因此每个文档可以独立于处理顺序而复制. 另有四个变体将同样的预算花在不同的模式上——只用替代,统一混合,连续2-4个字母连发,每行率不均匀——并在补充材料中加以界定和分析.

blocks.en: Edit types. Each edit is a substitution, an insertion or a deletion with probabilities 3:1:1. A substitution writes a uniformly random letter other than the original; an insertion (before the edited letter) a letter different from both neighbours; a deletion never removes a letter equal to a neighbour.
blocks.zh: 编辑类型。 每次编辑都是替换、插入或删除,概率为3:1:1。 替换者会写一个除原字母以外的统一随机字母;插入(在编辑后字母之前)一个与两个邻居不同的字母;删除后不会删除一个与邻居相等的字母.

blocks.en: Invariant. By construction every edit costs exactly one Levenshtein step, so the distance between the clean and the degraded letters of a document equals its edit count. This is verified on every document of every corpus.
blocks.zh: 无常. 通过构建每个编辑都花费了一个莱文施泰因步骤,所以一个文档的干净字母和退化字母之间的距离等于其编辑数. 这在每份文书上都有证实

blocks.en: Lost lines. Independently of letter noise, a seeded fraction p ∈ { 10 , 20 , 30 } % p\in\{10,20,30\}\% of a document’s text-bearing lines is dropped, crossed with c ∈ { 0 , 5 , 10 , 15 , 20 , 30 } % c\in\{0,5,10,15,20,30\}\% . CER is measured on the lines that remain, so the two kinds of loss stay separate: a line the layout analysis missed is not a letter the recogniser got wrong.
blocks.zh: 失去的线条。 在信噪声之外,一个种子分数p { { 10, 20, 30}% p\in { 10, 20, 30}一个文件的带文本行被丢弃, 与 c { { 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30}% c\in 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30} 交叉 。 CER在剩下的线上进行测量,所以这两种损失是分开的:漏掉的线条布局分析不是识别器错误的字母.

blocks.en: Grid and seeds. The CER grid is c c = 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15, 17.5, 20, 25, 30, 40 and 50%. Test corpora are degraded with three noise seeds, training and validation corpora with one seed each that is never shared with the test text; the 576 frozen corpora are released with the code.
blocks.zh: 网格与种子. CER网格为cc=0,1,2,3,5,7.5,10,12.5,15,17.5,20,25,30,40和50%. 测试蝎子以三个噪声种子降解,训练与验证蝎子,每个种子一个,从不与测试文本共享;576冷冻蝎子随代码释放.

blocks.en: 6 Models
blocks.zh: 6 模式

blocks.en: The models are deliberately small and trained in this study (Table 2 ); no external pretrained system other than the ByT5-small checkpoint is used. For each document-level task (T1–T3) we use one family from each of four kinds: a linear model on character n n -grams, a shallow embedding classifier, a character convolutional network and a pretrained byte-level transformer. Search uses eight untrained string and term-weighting methods.
blocks.zh: 这些型号特意是小型的,在本研究中经过训练(表2);除ByT5-小检查站外,没有使用外部预训系统. 对于每个文档级任务(T1–T3),我们使用来自每四种类型的一个家族:n-grams字符上的线性模型,浅嵌分类器,字符进化网络和预先训练的字节级变压器. 搜索使用8个未经训练的字符串和术语加权方法.

blocks.en: Table 2: Models. All hyperparameters are tuned once on the clean validation split and frozen.
blocks.zh: 表2:模型。 所有超参数都调整一次 在干净的验证分拆和冻结。

blocks.en: Two training regimes. R-clean trains on clean L3 and tests at every CER, which is what happens when a tool built on editions is pointed at HTR output. R-matched retrains at the test CER on training text degraded with its own seed, which is what a tool built for HTR output would do. CPU models are retrained at all 14 non-zero levels; the neural models at 5, 10, 15, 20 and 30%. At 0% both regimes are the same model.
blocks.zh: 两种培训制度。 清洁L3上的R-clean列车和每个CER的测试,这就是当一个基于版本的工具被指向HTR输出时会发生的情况. 在关于培训文本的CER测试中,R-匹配的重排以自己的种子退化,这是为HTR输出而建立的工具所能做的. CPU模型在所有14个非零级上都重新训练;神经模型为5,10,15,20和30%. 在0%时,两种制度都是相同的模式。

blocks.en: 7 Experimental protocol
blocks.zh: 7 实验协议

blocks.en: 7.1 Curves and intervals
blocks.zh: 7.1 曲线和间隔

blocks.en: Every task × \times model × \times regime gives a curve M ⁡ ( c ) M(c) of the headline metric against CER. Its uncertainty is a percentile bootstrap Efron and Tibshirani (1993) with 1,000 draws that resamples the evaluation units (documents, or queries for T4) and the noise seeds, using the same draws at every CER so that neighbouring points are paired. Metrics pool the seeds’ predictions rather than averaging per-seed scores. Model training is not resampled, so the intervals do not cover retraining variation.
blocks.zh: 每个任务 \times 模型 \times 制度给出一个曲线 M \(c) M(c) 对CER 标注. 它的不确定性是百分位的靴子Efron和Tibshirani(1993年),其中1000张画图重新标注了评估单元(文件,或T4的查询)和噪声种子,使用每个CER的相同画图,从而将相邻点对齐. 量子汇集了种子的预测而不是平均每种子得分。 模范培训没有被重印,因此间隔并不包括再培训的变化.

blocks.en: 7.2 Retention and thresholds
blocks.zh: 7.2 保留和阈值

blocks.en: Tasks live on different scales, so each curve is also expressed as retention , the share of clean performance kept: M ⁡ ( c ) / M ⁡ ( 0 ) M(c)/M(0) for higher-is-better metrics and M ⁡ ( 0 ) / M ⁡ ( c ) M(0)/M(c) for MAE, with a paired interval from the same draws, so that document-to-document variation shared by c c and 0 cancels. From the retention curve we read two thresholds: c 95 c_{95} ( c 90 c_{90} ) is the highest CER on the grid such that, at every level up to it, the 95% lower bound of retention is at least 0.95 (0.90). The contiguity requirement and the use of the lower bound make the thresholds conservative.
blocks.zh: 任务在不同的尺度上存在,因此每个曲线也表示为保留 ,干净性能保留的份额:M →(c) / M →(0) M(c) / M(0) 用于更高的比分,M →(0) / M →(c) M(c) 用于MAE, 与相同的图画有一个对接的间隔,因此文档对文件的变异由c和0取消共享. 从留存曲线来看,我们读取了两个阈值:c 95 c_{95}(c 90 c_{90})是电网上最高的CER,这样,在最高的每个水平上,95%的留存阈值至少是0.95 (0.90)。 毗连性要求和使用下限使门槛变得保守。

blocks.en: 7.3 Fragment size
blocks.zh: 7.3 碎片大小

blocks.en: Papyri are mostly small, and an average over documents is an average between fragments with 20 letters and papyrus scrolls containing 20,000 letters. Every curve is therefore also computed per size bin: letters per document (1–19, 20–49, 50–99, 100–199, 200–499, 500–999, 1,000–1,999, ≥ \geq 2,000) and text-bearing lines for T1–T3, letters per query for T4. Bins with fewer than 30 units get no threshold.
8 Results by task
blocks.zh: 第8条 按任务分列的结果

blocks.en: Each task has a figure with the headline curves of every model, trained on clean text and retrained at the test CER; Appendix 13 lists the thresholds per model. Numbers in the text are point estimates on the test split; intervals are in the figures and in the released tables.
blocks.zh: 每项任务都有一个图,上面有每个模型的头条曲线,受过干净文本的培训,并在测试CER上重新训练;附录13列出了每个模型的阈值. 文本中的数字是测试拆分时的点估计值;间隔在数字和发布的表格中.

blocks.en: 8.1 T1: document type
blocks.zh: 8.1 T1: 文档类型

blocks.en: Figure 2: T1 document type: macro-F1 of every model against CER. a Models trained on clean text and tested at every CER. b Models retrained at the test CER (the char-CNN and ByT5-small at 5, 10, 15, 20 and 30% only). Both panels share the legend and the axes
blocks.zh: 图2:T1文档类型:每个模型对CER的宏-F1. a 模式经清洁文本培训并在每个CER测试。 b 模型在测试CER(Char-CNN和ByT5-Small在5、10、15、20和30%的情况下)进行再培训。 两个板子都分享传说和轴

blocks.en: On clean text the linear model is clearly best: TF-IDF with logistic regression reaches macro-F1 0.909, with fastText, ByT5-small and the char-CNN between 0.811 and 0.857 (the neural models train on three of the five folds and stop early on a fourth, which accounts for part of the gap). Under noise the ranking inverts. Clean-trained TF-IDF loses little up to 10% CER and keeps 90% of its clean score to 12.5% (Appendix 13 ), then collapses to 0.163 at 30%, barely above the 0.121 majority-class baseline: the letter n n -grams it matches on stop occurring. The char-CNN, which scores local context rather than exact n n -grams, degrades gradually instead and is the best clean-trained model above 25% CER (0.466 at 30%). Retraining at the test CER removes most of that collapse — retrained TF-IDF scores 0.703 at 30% and is the best model from 20% up — while below 10% CER it brings nothing. At a fixed error rate the arrangement of the errors matters as much as their number (supplementary material), and losing 30% of the text-bearing lines costs less than 5% CER does.
blocks.zh: 在干净的文字上,线性模型明显最好:具有物流回归的TF-IDF达到宏-F1 0.909,其中快Text,ByT5小和Char-CNN在0.811到0.857之间(神经模型列车在五折中的三折上运行,在四折上提前停止,这占部分差距). 在噪音下,排名倒数。 清洁训练的TF-IDF损失小于10%的CER,并将其清洁分数的90%维持在12.5%(附录13),然后在30%时崩溃到0.163,略高于0.121多数级基准:n-gram这个字母在停止时匹配. Char-CNN对本地上下文进行评分,而不是精确的n-gm,而是逐渐降解,并且是最佳的清洁训练模式,超过25%的CER(0.466为30%)。 测试CER的再训练消除了大部分的崩溃——重新训练TF-IDF的分数为0.703分,从20%上升为最佳模式——而低于10%的CER则一无所获. 按固定错误计算,错误的安排与其数量(补充材料)一样重要,损失30%的含文本线的费用低于5%的CER。

blocks.en: 8.2 T2: dating

Figure 3: T2 dating: mean absolute error in years (lower is better) of every model against CER. a Models trained on clean text. b Models retrained at the test CER (the char-CNN and ByT5-small at 5, 10, 15, 20 and 30% only). Both panels share the legend and the axes
blocks.zh: 图3 T2 约会:指每个模型相对于CER的年份的绝对误差(较低更好). a 受过干净文本培训的模型。 3个P-4 型号在测试CER(Char-CNN和ByT5-small仅5,10,15,20和30%)时重新训练. 两个板子都分享传说和轴

blocks.en: Dating is the most fragile task in the study, and the only one where every model degrades at the same rate. On clean text fastText, predicting a probability-weighted midpoint over 25-year bins, dates test documents with a mean absolute error of 55 years, against 62 for the char-CNN, 72 for ByT5-small, 83 for ridge regression and 184 for the median-date baseline. Every model loses about a tenth of its accuracy by 5% CER and a fifth by 10%, so even the best keeps 90% of its clean accuracy only up to 3% CER (Appendix 13 ); at 20% the error is 97 years for fastText, and at 30% the char-CNN takes over. Retraining helps in proportion to the noise, cutting the char-CNN’s error from 138 to 111 years at 30% CER but nothing at 5%. No model reaches the century-level answer papyrologists ask for, even on perfectly transcribed text, so for dating the modelling question comes before the recognition one; fragment length matters more than a moderate error rate (Appendix 15 ).
blocks.zh: 约会是研究中最脆弱的任务,也是每个模型都以同样的速度降解的唯一任务. 关于净文本快件Text,预测25年桶的概率加权中点,日期测试文件的平均绝对误差为55年,Char-CNN为62年,ByT5-Small为72年,脊回归为83年,中位日期基线为184年。 每个模型的准确度损失了大约十分之一的CER 5%,五分之一的CER 10%,所以即使最好的模型也只保留了90%的清洁精度的CER 3%(附录13);在20%时,快速Text的误差为97年,Char-CNN占30%. 将CCN的误差从138年降至111年, 任何模型都达不到百年级的papyrlogists要求的答案,即使是在完全转录的文本上,所以在识别前都会出现建模问题;碎片长度比中等误差率更重要(附录15 ).

blocks.en: 8.3 T3: documentary versus literary
blocks.zh: 8.3 T3: 纪录片与文学

blocks.en: Figure 4: T3 documentary versus literary: macro-F1 of every model against CER, with the line-length-only shortcut. a Models trained on clean text. b Models retrained at the test CER (the char-CNN and ByT5-small at 5, 10, 15, 20 and 30% only). Both panels share the legend and the axes
blocks.zh: 图4:T3纪录片对文学:每个模型的宏-F1对CER,带有线长仅限的快捷键. a 受过干净文本培训的模型。 3个P-4 型号在测试CER(Char-CNN和ByT5-small仅5,10,15,20和30%)时重新训练. 两个板子都分享传说和轴

blocks.en: Telling a document from a literary text is the most robust task in the study. All four models score between 0.865 and 0.898 macro-F1 on clean text and lose little as the text degrades: TF-IDF keeps 0.852 at 20% CER and 0.796 at 30%, holding 90% of its clean score up to 20% CER, twice the tolerance of any other task (Appendix 13 ). The signal is lexical and spread over the whole text, which is why scattered errors cost so little; the control model that sees only line-length statistics stays at 0.57 whatever the CER, so the number of lines and amount of letters do not give the answer away. Retraining pays only under heavy noise (0.727 at 50% CER). The real limit is length rather than error rate: fragments under 20 letters are near chance even on clean text, while texts of 500 letters or more keep 90% of their score up to 20% CER (Appendix 15 ). Only 3.4% of evaluated test documents are literary, so macro-F1 rather than accuracy carries the headline.
blocks.zh: 从文学文本中说出文件是研究中最有力的任务. 所有四个模型在干净文本上得分在0.865到0.898宏-F1之间,在文本退化时损失很少: TF-IDF将0.852维持在20%CER,0.796维持在30%,持有90%的干净分数维持在20%CER,是任何其他任务的容忍度的两倍(附录13). 信号具有词典性,并分布在整个文本中,这就是为什么零散的错误成本如此之低;只看到线长统计的控制模型无论CER是什么,都停留在0.57,因此行数和字母数量不会给出答案. 重新训练只在强烈噪音下支付(0.727,占CER的50%). 真正的极限是长度而不是误差率:20个字母下的碎片即使在干净的文本上也几乎是偶然的,而500个或更多字母的文本则将90%的得分保留到20%的CER(附录15 ). 只有3.4%的评估测试文件是文学的,所以宏-F1而不是精度带有标题.

blocks.en: 8.4 T4: search
Figure 5: T4 search: document-level recall@20 of the ranking methods over all 2,534 queries against CER. The search methods need no training, so there is a single panel
blocks.zh: 图5:T4检索:针对CER的所有2,534个查询的排名方法的文档级别召回@20. 搜索方法不需要训练,所以只有一个面板

blocks.en: Search separates into ranking and filtering. Ranking by minimum edit distance is the most robust and the most predictable method in the study: document-level recall@20 falls almost linearly, by about 1.6 points per point of CER, from 0.93 at 5% CER to 0.68 at 20% and 0.51 at 30%. Term-weighting schemes fare worse under noise than their clean scores suggest. BM25, tuned on clean validation queries, chose 6-letter n n -grams and so behaves almost like exact containment: perfect on clean text, but 0.29 at 30% CER against 0.51 for edit distance, a reminder that tuning a retrieval method on clean text selects for brittleness. Filtering fails differently: exact match keeps its precision as the text degrades (0.84 at 20% CER) and loses recall instead, which is the safer failure for a scholar asking whether a formula occurs at all. Query length drives everything — queries of ten letters or more tolerate 20% CER, queries of three to six letters only 3% (Appendix 15 ) — and formulae survive far better than dictionary stems, so searching noisy text for a long phrase stays reliable long after single-word search has failed.
blocks.zh: 搜索分为排名和过滤. 按最小编辑距离排序是研究中最有力和最可预测的方法:文档级别召回@20几乎直线下降,每CER点约1.6分,从0.93分5%的CER下降到0.68分的20%和0.51分的30%。 时间加权方案在噪音下的价格比干净的分数所显示的要差。 BM25基于干净的验证查询,选择了6个字母n -gram,因此行为几乎像精确的封装:完美于干净的文本,但0.29 以30%的CER对0.51的编辑距离,提醒人们在干净的文本上调用一种检索方法,以选择脆度。 过滤失败不同: 准确匹配在文本降解时保持精确度( 0. 84 at 20% CER) , 反而会失去记忆, 对于一个询问公式是否发生的学者来说, 这是更安全的失败 。 查询长度驱动一切——查询十个字母或以上可以容忍20%的CER,查询三至六个字母只能容忍3%(附录15)——公式生存得远胜于词典的衍生,因此搜索吵闹的文字一个长短语在单词搜索失败后很长一段时间内仍然可靠.

blocks.en: 9 Cross-task findings
blocks.zh: 9 跨任务调查结果

blocks.en: 9.1 Retraining on noisy text
blocks.zh: 9.1 国家 对吵闹的文本进行再培训

blocks.en: Below 10% CER retraining is never better and sometimes slightly worse, so a tool built on editions can be pointed at good HTR as it is. From 15% CER on, and dramatically at 30%, retraining undoes most of the collapse of the lexical models: document form from 0.163 to 0.703, and even the char-CNN gains (0.466 to 0.592). Much of the loss at high CER is therefore a train–test mismatch, not lost information. Dating recovers less: retraining removes only about a quarter of the added error at 30% CER (fastText 142 to 124 years, char-CNN 138 to 111), so here a larger part of the loss is information that the noise has destroyed. Documentary-versus-literary, which barely collapses, gains only beyond 30% (0.645 to 0.727 at 50%). For the papyrologist the message is encouraging. A model that has seen noisy text is not merely more robust; at 20–30% CER, the range in which today’s systems read cursive documentary hands, it is the difference between a usable classifier and a useless one, and it costs nothing but training on degraded copies of the same editions.
blocks.zh: 低于10%的CER再培训从来没有好过,有时也略微差过,因此在版本上建立的工具可以指向好的HTR的原样. 从15%的CER到30%,再培训大大消除了词汇模型的大部分崩溃:文档形式从0.163到0.703,甚至Char-CNN收益(0.466到0.592). 因此,在高CER中损失的很大一部分是火车-测试不匹配,而不是丢失信息。 约会恢复较少:再培训只消除30%CER(快讯142到124年,char-CNN138到111年)新增错误的四分之一左右,因此这里损失的很大一部分是噪音已经破坏的信息. 纪录片对文学几乎崩溃,只增加30%以上(0.645到0.727,50%)。 对于乳腺科医生来说,信息令人鼓舞。 一个看到吵闹文本的模型并不仅仅是更坚固的;在20-30%的CER,即当今系统读取咒语的纪录手的范围,是可用分类器和无用的分类器之间的区别,它除了培训同一版本的退化拷贝之外,成本不菲。

blocks.en: 9.2 Lost lines
blocks.zh: 9.2 国家 丢失线条

blocks.en: Missing a line altogether is a different failure from misreading one, and it costs far less. Dropping 30% of the text-bearing lines is worth about as much as 5% CER for the document-level tasks, while for search it removes recall in proportion to the text lost. The ablation and its figure are in Appendix 14 .
blocks.zh: 漏掉一条线 与误读一条是不同的失败 成本要低得多 在文档级别的任务中,删除30%的带文本的行值约为5%的CER,而为了搜索,它会按照丢失文本的比例去除召回. 附录14中载有该修正案及其数字。

blocks.en: 9.3 Fragment size
blocks.zh: 9.3 碎片大小

blocks.en: Every task has a size below which no CER helps and a size above which a large CER is survivable. Because the effect is essentially the same for all four tasks, the figure and its discussion are in Appendix 15 .
blocks.zh: 每项任务都有一个体积,低于这个体积的CER没有帮助,一个体积大的CER能够存活。 由于所有四项任务的效果基本相同,因此该数字及其讨论载于附录15。

blocks.en: 10 Discussion
blocks.zh: 10 讨论情况

blocks.en: 10.1 What HTR quality is required for what
blocks.zh: 10.1 (中文(简体) ). 什么要求HTR质量

blocks.en: Table 3 turns the thresholds into targets, read against what current systems report: low single digits on clear hands, ten to twenty percent on documentary cursive. Three groups emerge. Documentary-versus-literary classification works on today’s output as it is; document type and search require good HTR output, or retraining on degraded editions, after which document type identification lies within reach of typical HTR output for cursive handwriting. Dating needs either very good HTR or a better model, since the text alone does not give a century-level answer even when perfectly transcribed.
blocks.zh: 表3将阈值转化为目标,与当前系统报告的内容相对照:清晰的手持低位数,记录咒语的10%至20%。 出现三组. 文献对文学的分类对今天的输出起到了作用;文件类型和搜索需要良好的HTR输出,或者对退化的版本进行再培训,在此之后,文件类型识别就能够从典型的HTR输出中获取,用于校正笔迹。 约会需要的是非常好的HTR或者更好的模型,因为单是文本即使完全转写,也不会给出世纪级的答案.

blocks.en: 10.2 Recommendations

For HTR developers: report a letters-only CER computed after the normalisation of Sect. 5.2 , and report it by fragment size and the line-loss rate separately, because each of these changes what the CER means downstream. For tool builders: train on degraded editions at the CER the HTR is expected to produce; the degradation algorithm and the frozen corpora are released for this purpose. For papyrologists and collection curators: automatic first-pass transcription over unedited material at 10–20% CER already supports selection of relevant papyri for publication and, with retrained models, cataloguing by document type; searching this transcription layer with edit-distance ranking and queries of ten letters or more is reliable; dating established from such transcription should be treated as a hint.
blocks.zh: 对于 HTR 开发者: 报告一个在 第 5.2 节实现正常化后计算的仅字母的CER, 并按片段大小和线损率分别报告,因为这些变化都改变了CER在下游的含义。 对于工具构建者:在CER上对退化版的列车,HTR预计将产生;为此发布降解算法和冷冻蝎子. 对帕皮尔学家和收藏家来说:10–20%的CER自动第一通道抄录在未经编辑的材料上,已经支持选择相关的papyri供出版,并且通过重新训练的模型,按文件类型进行编目;通过编辑-距离排列和询问10个或10个以上字母来搜索这个抄录层是可靠的;从这种抄录中确定的日期应作为提示对待。

blocks.en: 10.3 Limitations

The noise is simulated: real HTR errors are shaped by letter confusions, the hand, the damage and the recogniser, and our variants only bracket that. The thresholds should therefore be re-read once a system produces aligned output at scale, which the released pipeline makes a matter of replacing one step. Only letter errors and lost lines are modelled, not merged or split lines, wrong reading order or fragments joined out of order. The tasks use small, self-trained models; a larger pretrained model may be more or less robust, though the retrained results suggest that the training regime matters more than the architecture. Finally, the study covers Greek only; Latin and Coptic replications use the same pipeline and are in progress.
blocks.zh: 噪音是模拟的:真实的HTR错误是由字母混淆,手,损伤和识别器塑造的,而我们的变体则只将这个框. 因此,一旦一个系统产生规模一致的输出,即应重新读取阈值,而释放的输油管需要更换一个步骤。 只有字母错误和丢失的行是模型化的,而不是合并或分割的行,错误的读取顺序或片段脱离顺序合并. 这些任务使用小型的自训练模式;更大的预训练模式可能或多或少是坚固的,尽管重新训练的结果表明,培训制度比结构更重要。 最后,这项研究涉及: 仅希腊语;拉丁语和科普特语的复制使用相同的管道,正在进行中.

blocks.en: 11 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 11 结论

blocks.en: We asked how good HTR of Greek papyri must be for the tasks papyrologists would want to run on it, and answered per task with controlled experiments on 63,846 edited texts reduced to what a perfect HTR would return and degraded to exact error rates. The tolerance spans close to an order of magnitude: from 20% CER for telling documents from literature to 3% for dating, with document type identification and search between. A perfect transcription is not needed, and a single CER figure is not enough: what matters is the CER for the task at hand, the shape of the errors, the length of the fragment, and, above all, whether the downstream model has seen noisy text. Retraining on degraded editions turns output at 20–30% CER, the range current systems reach on documentary hands, from useless into usable for document classification at no cost beyond training. The corpus rules, the degradation algorithm, the frozen corpora, the models and every result table are released so that the thresholds can be re-read as HTR systems improve and as real output becomes available.
blocks.zh: 我们问希腊papyri的HTR对工作有多好, 帕皮里医生想运行它, 耐受程度接近一个数量级:从20%的CER用于从文献中显示文件,到3%用于约会,文件类型识别和在两者之间搜索。 不需要完美的复制,单一个CER数字是不够的:对于手头的任务来说,CER很重要,错误的形状,碎片的长度,最重要的是,下游模型是否看到了吵闹的文字. 对退化版的再培训将输出量变为20-30%的CER, 目前的范围系统覆盖在文件手上,从无用到可用于文件分类,除了培训之外没有其他费用。 命题规则,降解算法,冷冻的corpora,模型和每个结果表都被释放出来,以便随着HTR系统的改进以及实际输出的出现,阈值可以重新读取.

blocks.en: 14 Lost lines
blocks.zh: 第 14 条 丢失线条

blocks.en: A recogniser can fail in two ways that a single CER figure does not distinguish: it can read a line and get its letters wrong, or it can miss the line altogether, because the layout analysis did not find it or because the ink is too faint to segment. The second failure removes text rather than corrupting it, so it is modelled separately (Sect. 5.3 ): a seeded fraction p p of a document’s text-bearing lines is dropped before the letter noise is applied, and the CER is measured on the lines that remain. The two losses therefore compose without being confounded. Figure 1 crosses p ∈ { 0 , 10 , 20 , 30 } % p\in\{0,10,20,30\}\% with c ∈ { 0 , … , 30 } % c\in\{0,\dots,30\}\% for each task, using the model that carries that task’s headline on clean text.
blocks.zh: 识别器可以两种方式失败,即单个CER图无法区分:它可以读取一行并错误地得到其字母,或者它可以完全错过该行,因为布局分析没有找到它,或者因为墨水太微弱无法分解. 第二次失败会删除文本而不是腐蚀文本,因此它会被分别模拟(第5.3节): 在使用字母噪声之前,将文件的含文本线的种子分数p降下,并按留下的线段测量CER。 因此,这两项损失都是不令人困惑的。 图1显示p { 0, 10, 20, 30}% p\in 0, 10, 20, 30} 与 c\ { 0, ..., 30}% c\in\ 0,\ dots, 30} 用于每项任务, 使用该任务头条在干净文本上的模型 。

blocks.en: For the three document-level tasks, losing lines costs strikingly little. On clean text, dropping 30% of the lines lowers document type from 0.909 to 0.881 macro-F1 and documentary versus literary from 0.898 to 0.885, and raises the dating error from 83 to 94 years — in each case about what 5% CER costs on its own, for a third of the text removed. The curves in panels a – c stay close to parallel as the error rate rises, so the two kinds of loss add up almost independently rather than compounding; above 20% CER they converge, because a text that noisy carries little signal whether or not a third of it is missing.
blocks.zh: 就三个文件级任务而言,失去线路的代价非常低。 在干净的文字上,将30%的行数从0.909降到0.881宏F1,将文件类型从0.898降到0.885,并将约会错误从83年增加到94年,每行都涉及到5%的CER成本,有三分之一的文字被删除。 面板中的曲线a-c随着误差率的上升而接近平行,因此这两种损失几乎是独立的,而不是复合的;超过20%的CER会汇合起来,因为一个吵闹的文本几乎不包含它是否缺少三分之一的信号。

blocks.en: Search behaves differently (panel d ). A lost line cannot be found, so recall falls in proportion to the text removed rather than with the difficulty of matching: min-edit recall@20 drops from 1.000 to 0.820 on clean text when 30% of the lines are gone, the largest single effect of line loss in the study, and the gap stays roughly constant at every CER.
blocks.zh: 搜索行为不同(pageel d). 无法找到一条丢失的行, 因此提醒与删除的文字成正比, 而非匹配的难度: min-edit record@20在30%的行消失时, 在干净的文字上从1. 000降至0. 820, 这是研究中失去的线的最大单一效果, 空隙在每一个CER时大致保持不变 。

blocks.en: The practical consequence is that a layout stage that misses a third of the lines is a much smaller problem for classification and dating than a recogniser that gets a fifth of the letters wrong, while for search the two matter about equally, since one removes what the other corrupts. This is the argument for reporting the line-loss rate alongside the CER (Sect. 10 ).
blocks.zh: 其实际后果是,漏掉三分之一行的布局阶段,在分类和约会方面,一个比获得五分之一字母错误的识别器要小得多,而为了同样地搜索这两个事项,因为一个消除了其他的腐败。 这就是与CER一起报告线性损失率的理由(第10节)。

blocks.en: 15 Fragment size
blocks.zh: 15 碎片大小

blocks.en: Every task has a size below which no CER helps and a size above which a large CER is survivable (Fig. 1 ). Fragments under 20 letters are dated with a 121-year error and are at chance for documentary versus literary on clean text; texts of 500 letters or more keep 90% of their document-type and documentary-literary scores up to 12.5–20% CER and documents of 2,000 letters up to 30–40% for the latter. Search follows the query rather than the document: 10–12-letter queries tolerate 20% CER, 3–6-letter queries 3%. One counter-intuitive detail: on document type the longest clean-trained TF-IDF documents collapse hardest at 30% CER (0.071 macro-F1 for 1,000–1,999 letters, Fig. 1 a), because they accumulate the largest number of unseen noisy n n -grams; retraining removes the effect.
